rules.licence: GraphQL licenseInfo.spdxId on prereg.json's licences is kept (licence_from graphql); null or NOASSERTION goes to section 5's second read, recorded in b1-licences.json and b2-licences.json: kept with its raw spdxId (licence_from files) when at least one root LICENSE*, LICENCE* or COPYING* file is found and every one matches a listed licence (ordinary/licences.ts classifyLicenceFiles), dropped as licence_files_no_file or licence_files_unmatched otherwise, and kept with second_read_pending true while no second read is recorded for it; any other spdxId is dropped as licence_not_permissive
rules.title: \bfix(e[sd]|ing)?\b
rules.statement: the one closing issue's title, a blank line, then its body; only its sha256 and length are kept
